answer.diagnosis: A 3x3 patch in the top-left corner (rows 1-3, columns 1-3) carries very large weights, magnitude about 50-99, in most structured layer-1 units. This patch is far from the central blob. Units 1, 7, 11, 12, 14, 16 and 19 have strong positive weights there. Units 3, 5, 8, 10, 17, 20, 23, 25, 30 and 31 have strong negative weights there. The sign of the patch tracks the sign of each unit's centre or ring blob-size detector: units that respond to a large central disc are positive on the patch, and units with a negative centre or ring are negative on it. A bright marker in that corner therefore pushes the logit the same way as a large blob does. This is a spurious corner-marker shortcut that is not related to blob size. The blob-size features themselves (the central disc and ring patterns) are separate and stay intact.
